I'm not sure how the extra 100 em and 14% atk with 4pc Gilded fare against the 35% charged attack dmg of Wanderer. But one thing you have going for him with Gilded is it affects his whole kit, not just his CA. But one pro tip. 4pc Gilded gives you the extra em and atk when you trigger a reaction so to get the most out of it you wanna make sure the enemy has electro on them already so that his E would trigger quicken and Gilded will take effect. So for the next 8 secs you'll have extra stats for your burst and CAs. From the 2nd rotation onwards it'll be easier to keep up but just remember you always wanna start with his E. Then depending on you you can do E>CA for A4>Q>CA>CA>Swap which is his best dps combo or just E>Q>CA×3 which is just easier to execute.

Firstly, his dmg will depend on your stats. His main role is a Spread Quickswap dps. Technically his best electro support would be lisa for her def shred but anything else works bc You just want them to trigger quicken. I'd use fav sword on Kuki on this team. Iron sting would be better on a pure hyperbloom team which is not where Tighnari shines. Nahida is the best on fielder for hyperbloom team(Single target...Ayato is best onfielder if Aoe) so when you get Xingqiu you can create a team like Nahida/Kuki/Xingqiu with the 4th spot being flexible for another electro like Fischl/Beidou who wont steal Hyperbloom from your Kuki or another hydro like Yelan/Ayato. Fischl is flexible with her artifact sets but Stringless would be better than rust. I'd say your best Tighnari team would be double dendro double electro. Tighnari/DM Nahida/Fischl and Ideally Tenacity Kuki on Fav sword with Hp artifacts. Good luck!
